inv.desc_en: Barbershop (can also be for ladies) currently in operation. For transfer due to inability to attend to it. It has all the necessary services to be operational in this sector. 3 workstations.. . reception with waiting area.. . cabin. 3 shampoo stations. Storage room with washer, dryer, and water heater specific to these services. Cabinets and kitchen area for eating. Shutters. Air conditioning (hot and cold).. . 2 bathrooms. Also, note that all electricity and telephone services remain active, with power and other utilities still connected, so you can start working tomorrow if desired.
